SELECT t1.mg_cd AS mgCd , t1.fund_cd AS fundCd , t1.fund_nm AS fundNm , t1.fund_nm AS xxFundCd , NVL(t2.work_gb, 'A') AS workGb , TO_CHAR(t1.fst_seolj_ymd, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS fstSeoljYmd , t2.gijun_ga AS gijunGa , t2.ggijun_ga AS ggijunGa , t1.type_gb AS typeGb , F_FUND_COLOR(#{corpGr}, t1.fund_cd, TO_DATE(REPLACE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), '.', ''), 'YYYYMMDD')) AS fundColor FROM SZM0IA t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN SKT0GI t2 ON t2.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr AND t2.ymd = TO_DATE(REPLACE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), '.', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') AND t2.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd WHERE t1.corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND t1.fst_seolj_ymd <= TO_DATE(REPLACE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), '.', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') AND NVL(t1.haeji_ymd, TO_DATE(REPLACE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), '.', ''), 'YYYYMMDD')) >= TO_DATE(REPLACE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), '.', ''), 'YYYYMMDD')
AND t1.mg_cd LIKE #{mgCd}
AND t1.mg_cd LIKE '%'
ORDER BY t1.mg_cd, t1.fund_nm, NVL(t2.work_gb, 'A'), t1.fund_currency DESC
